cause.visibility: chooseItems only appended a birthday group when an unoccupied chart row remained; a full agenda silently omitted it.
cause.position: The old textY used centerY - fontSize/2 - 4 while drawTextInRect received a 1.2×fontSize box, leaving rendered glyphs above the thermal band's center.

solution.selection: Birthday groups bypass chart-row allocation and overflow counting. They are also excluded from the row-count heuristic, so birthdays do not compress event/reminder chart rows.
solution.layerOrder: The thermal band is painted first, birthdays next, then arrival/start guides and event/reminder charts and titles. Existing foreground boundaries, weather markers and rain overlays still render later.
solution.placement: Birthday text is placed in the center of the thermal graph band, with font-size-specific optical corrections (2 logical px for 28 px and 1 logical px for 26 px in the local renderer). Adjacent day groups reserve horizontal space to prevent their names from overlapping. Existing rounded-widget clipping remains active.
solution.lateDayVisibility: A birthday interval that overlaps the rolling window remains eligible at 23:59 even when its remaining all-day duration is narrower than the rounded edge inset; its label continues from the date origin as designed.

validation.fixture: Synthetic six-event / four-reminder agenda, three birthdays on one date and one on the next date; no personal calendar data.
validation.selection: Selected event and reminder identifiers and overflow marker match the 0.3.40 baseline in all five scenes. Five-event control confirms birthday presence does not change chart row count. All three same-day birthday labels remain visible with all chart rows occupied.
validation.layering: Canvas operations confirm thermal/base drawing precedes birthday labels and event titles follow them. Pixel-bounds test confirms adjacent date groups do not overlap horizontally.

opticalCenter.fontSubstitute: Open Sans ExtraBold on @napi-rs/canvas; not the native iOS SF Pro font.

validation.continuousIntegration: No Scripting-specific GitHub Actions workflow exists in this checkout; only the Android workflow is configured. The Scripting checks above passed locally.
validation.physicalIOS: Not tested. Synthetic rendering uses desktop fonts and Canvas and cannot establish exact SF Pro ink metrics or widget behavior on an iPhone.
validation.iosRefresh: Widget refresh timing remains controlled by iOS.
